summary: Destructor that conditionally frees a heap sub-object referenced at this+0x180 (this[96]) when non-null, calls a cleanup wrapper (FunctionCallWrapper_9440, 0x00489440) on the object itself, then, when the a2&1 flag is set, frees the containing object through FreeWrapper_7bcf (0x00587BCF). Returns the this pointer. Part of the object destruction system.

local_names.this: object being destroyed; owns a sub-object pointer at +0x180
local_names.a2: destructor flag; bit 0 selects whether the containing object itself is freed

operations.description: Proceed to free the sub-object only when this[96] (this+0x180) is non-null
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the sub-object at this+0x180 when the null guard passes
FunctionCallWrapper_9440 performs additional cleanup/deinitialization on this object
When the a2 & 1 flag is set, the containing this object is freed after cleanup
FreeWrapper_7bcf frees the containing object when the a2&1 guard passes

unresolved: The specific cleanup performed by FunctionCallWrapper_9440 and the meaning of the freed sub-object at this+0x180 are outside this function's evidence
